adjudication.rationale: The dialog’s client-side validation (AddGuestsDialog.tsx) only enforces email format and uniqueness within the submitted array (ZAddGuestsInputSchema with Set-based refine). It does not check against existing booking attendees, while the backend handler filters out emails already present (addGuests.handler.ts uniqueGuests filter) and throws BAD_REQUEST when the filtered list is empty. This can lead to a UX edge case where re-adding an already-invited email passes client validation but fails server-side with a generic "emails_must_be_unique_valid" message rather than a specific "already invited" message. However, it’s not strictly a correctness bug since the backend rejects it and surfaces an error toast; it’s more an incomplete/unclear error handling case introduced by the change.
